data.title: Blank Credit Card Subscription Fraud Pattern Detection
data.description: Detects patterns consistent with blank credit card subscription fraud as operated by VexTrio/Ad Trafficko and similar affiliate fraud platforms. In this scheme, affiliates deploy customizable credit card capture templates offering low-cost items ("Free iPhone, $1.99 shipping" or "Walmart gift card, $0.99 shipping"). Victims enter card details believing they are paying a nominal fee; the platform charges a higher amount ($9.99 typical) and enrolls them in recurring subscriptions generating ongoing charges. Affiliate payouts reach $120 per successful lead. This rule targets the transaction monitoring layer to identify: (1) initial nominal-amount card-not-present charges from newly registered or unknown merchants followed by recurring charges at higher amounts, (2) merchant descriptor patterns consistent with subscription enrollment services, (3) high chargeback ratios from merchants exhibiting these patterns. Source: Black Hat USA 2025 (Infoblox VexTrio deanonymization).

queries.cql:
// CrowdStrike CQL for Blank Credit Card Subscription Fraud Pattern Detection
// Identifies nominal-charge-to-recurring-subscription patterns (Ad Trafficko model)
transaction_type="CNP"
| is_nominal := if(amount<=2.99, 1, 0)
| is_recurring := if(transaction_type="recurring" AND amount>=6.99, 1, 0)
| groupBy(merchant_id, function=[
    sum(is_nominal, as=nominal_charges),
    sum(is_recurring, as=recurring_charges),
    count(field=card_hash, distinct=true, as=unique_cards),
    avg(amount, as=avg_amount),
    max(amount, as=max_amount),
    collect([merchant_descriptor]),
    max(merchant_chargeback_ratio, as=chargeback_ratio)
  ])
| nominal_charges > 10 AND recurring_charges > 5
| conversion_ratio := round(recurring_charges / nominal_charges * 100) / 100
| filter(conversion_ratio > 0.3 OR chargeback_ratio > 0.05)
| sort(recurring_charges, order=desc)
queries.splunk:
`comment("Splunk SPL for Blank CC Subscription Fraud Pattern Detection")`
`comment("Identifies nominal-charge-to-recurring-subscription patterns (Ad Trafficko model)")`
index=flame_txn sourcetype=flame:card_transactions transaction_type=CNP
| eval is_nominal=(if(amount<=2.99, 1, 0))
| eval is_recurring_followup=(if(transaction_type="recurring" AND amount>=6.99, 1, 0))
| stats
    sum(is_nominal) AS nominal_charges
    sum(is_recurring_followup) AS recurring_charges
    dc(card_hash) AS unique_cards
    avg(amount) AS avg_amount
    max(amount) AS max_amount
    values(merchant_descriptor) AS descriptors
    latest(merchant_chargeback_ratio) AS chargeback_ratio
  by merchant_id
| where nominal_charges > 10 AND recurring_charges > 5
| eval conversion_ratio=round(recurring_charges/nominal_charges, 2)
| where conversion_ratio > 0.3 OR chargeback_ratio > 0.05
| sort -recurring_charges
queries.sql:
-- SQL for Blank CC Subscription Fraud Pattern Detection
-- Identifies merchants exhibiting nominal-to-recurring subscription fraud patterns
WITH initial_charges AS (
  SELECT card_hash, merchant_id, merchant_descriptor, amount,
         transaction_date, transaction_id
  FROM card_transactions
  WHERE transaction_type = 'CNP'
    AND amount <= 2.99
    AND transaction_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
),
followup_subscriptions AS (
  SELECT card_hash, merchant_id, amount,
         transaction_date, transaction_type
  FROM card_transactions
  WHERE transaction_type = 'recurring'
    AND amount >= 6.99
    AND transaction_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
)
SELECT
  ic.merchant_id,
  ic.merchant_descriptor,
  COUNT(DISTINCT ic.transaction_id) AS nominal_charge_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT fs.card_hash) AS cards_enrolled_recurring,
  AVG(fs.amount) AS avg_recurring_amount,
  m.chargeback_ratio,
  m.registration_date
FROM initial_charges ic
JOIN followup_subscriptions fs
  ON ic.card_hash = fs.card_hash
  AND ic.merchant_id = fs.merchant_id
  AND fs.transaction_date BETWEEN ic.transaction_date AND ic.transaction_date + INTERVAL '7 days'
JOIN merchant_profiles m ON ic.merchant_id = m.merchant_id
GROUP BY ic.merchant_id, ic.merchant_descriptor, m.chargeback_ratio, m.registration_date
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ic.transaction_id) > 10
   AND COUNT(DISTINCT fs.card_hash) > 5
ORDER BY cards_enrolled_recurring DESC;

falsepositives: Legitimate free trial offers that convert to paid subscriptions (though legitimate merchants typically have lower chargeback ratios)
Promotional shipping offers from established e-commerce merchants
Subscription box services with nominal initial trial charges
